title: The verifier proves deadlock freedom
text: The same two workers now take the locks in one order: `lockA` first, then `lockB`. The verifier proves deadlock freedom (`lockA`, `lockB` and `done` are sinks) by enumerating all 7 reachable state classes, and proves at most one worker holds both locks without exploring at all, from the linear bound `holdsA + holdsBoth + lockA ≤ 1`.

steps.text: The first worker takes `lockA`. The second cannot start: `lockA` is empty.
The first worker takes `lockB` as well.
It finishes and returns both locks.
Both jobs are done and both locks are back: every token rests in a sink.
